title: AI Connector Interface

list_models.description: Models are addressed by opaque modelref handles and filtered by required modalities only.
list_models.claim_boundary: No provider model catalog is fetched locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

execute.description: Execution is denied without its declared permission, an opaque model reference, and an explicit data destination.
execute.claim_boundary: No inference request is issued to a provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

stream.description: Streaming is denied for models that do not declare streaming support, and chunks must be strictly ordered with exactly one final chunk.
stream.claim_boundary: No live token stream is consumed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

cancel.description: Cancellation fails closed without explicit reauthentication and is unsupported for models that do not declare it.
cancel.claim_boundary: No remote inference cancellation is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

usage.description: Usage reporting follows the 119.13 quota and usage value shape with explicit units, periods, and freshness.
usage.claim_boundary: No provider usage meter is read locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

cost_metadata.description: Cost metadata is validated (ISO-4217 currency, non-negative finite unit cost, named unit label) and is never treated as a bill.
cost_metadata.claim_boundary: No provider pricing feed is trusted or reconciled. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

destination.description: Every execution declares where prompt and completion data may travel; an unknown destination is denied outright.
destination.claim_boundary: No provider data-processing agreement is verified locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Health reports unavailable, degraded, or ok deterministically from caller-supplied local signals.
health.claim_boundary: Health is computed from local signals, not a live provider probe. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local AI connector interface contract, not a live inference client.
No prompt text, completion text, credential, or provider account identifier is stored or returned.
Live inference, streaming, cancellation, usage metering, and pricing remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
